_label: SCRIPTED founder inputs for demo runs. Interview notes, demand results, support questions and phase 6 results are SAMPLE / MOCKED inputs, not real data.
clarify_target_customer: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and MENA who juggle several clients
clarify_problem: They lose track of project status, revision rounds and unpaid invoices
clarify_product_type: Digital template pack (Notion and Google Sheets)
clarify_founder_skills: 4 years freelance design; Notion, Google Sheets, Canva; no coding
clarify_differentiation: Bilingual Arabic and English, built for local freelancing habits
clarify_values_and_limits: No lock-in subscriptions; never collects client data
interview_notes: SAMPLE interview notes (not real interviews). A: tracks projects in WhatsApp chats and a notebook; lost one unpaid invoice last month. B: tried a free Trello board, stopped updating it after two weeks. C: has never paid for a template; would ask a friend first.
support_questions: SAMPLE questions: 1) Can I use the template in Arabic? 2) I bought it twice by mistake, can I get my money back? 3) Does it work on the Notion free plan?
_gate_1_override: Founder decision (human): if the system recommends STOP at Gate 1, reject it and continue with 'go'. Only a Gate 1 STOP is rejected (approvals.gate_1_stop); a Gate 1 GO or REPEAT, and every later gate, is approved as the system recommends. The system's own Gate 1 verdict stays unchanged in phase1_gate_decision.md.
_gate_2_override: Founder decision (human): if the system recommends STOP at Gate 2, reject it and continue with 'go'. Only a Gate 2 STOP is rejected (approvals.gate_2_stop). The system's own Gate 2 verdict stays unchanged in phase2_gate_decision.md; the override is in phase2_gate_founder_override.md and in decision_log.json (approved_by: founder).
